new_proofs: Directed continuous nonnegative costs have integral equal to supremum of directed integrals by Radon regularity and finite compact covers; no arbitrary measurable-net monotone convergence.
Objective supremum equals model-envelope supremum; quadratic genuine contraction gives uniform near-maximizer costs.
Uniform finite model Taylor estimates pass as entire fixed increments to every genuine base with exactly the same constants.
Both approximate-stationarity signs show model near-maximizer outputs converge weakly to arbitrary intrinsic finite-dual-energy target before attainment.
Optional ordered-gap C0 absolute approximants below the fixed cost pass to the prescribed target via nonnegative LSC Portmanteau, giving fixed-test weighted integrals and tails.
primary_source_claim: No new external specialized theorem invoked beyond the explicitly unproved manuscript foundations. Elementary Radon directed-integration argument and passage of uniform increments are proved in full; compact-Hausdorff weak Radon Portmanteau and uniform-density weak-test extension are ordinary background.
limitations: No attainment at a genuine cluster or control of simultaneously changing tests; full mixed identification, strict Borel comparison and every-solution uniqueness still open.
